display.purpose: Page titles (page header), landing section heads, dialog titles. Condensed 78%, heavy, tight: 2.6rem phone, 3rem desktop, 3.5rem dashboard greeting, up to 7.5rem landing wordmark.

headline.purpose: Featured session title in the dashboard court panel and empty-state statements.

title.purpose: Card and section titles at normal width.

body.purpose: Descriptions and running text, capped near 42rem.

label.purpose: Condensed uppercase label naming a box, field group, stat or small section. Never a kicker above a page heading.

numeral.purpose: Minutes, counts, clocks and time ranges: condensed 75%, tabular figures.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Every card and panel at rest (light). Dark: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03), 0 12px 30px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75).

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover on interactive cards, with a 2px rise (light). Dark: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04), 0 18px 36px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8).

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, toasts, the landing hero sheet (light). Dark: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05), 0 28px 56px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85).

shadows.name: button-primary-edge
shadows.purpose: The printed edge on the orange primary button.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Enters, colour changes, popovers, dialogs, collapse.

motion.name: motion-slow
motion.purpose: Content fade-up, list stagger items, the changed mark.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Anything entering or answering the pointer.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Things moving on screen, exits, collapse.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every button, chip and icon button on :active.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: First-load list and grid entrance only.

motion.name: tally-fill
motion.value: clip-path wipe from the left, 360ms ease-out
motion.purpose: A tally block added while the coach watches.

motion.name: tally-strike
motion.value: 2px orange stroke, scaleX 0 to 1 then fade, 520ms ease-out
motion.purpose: The strike across a freshly added tally block.

motion.name: changed-mark
motion.value: 3px orange left bar, scaleY in over 240ms
motion.purpose: A row that just moved or arrived, held until the next interaction.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations to 0.01ms; footage replaced by its poster
motion.purpose: All movement off under prefers-reduced-motion and in print.

components.name: Running Tally
components.description: The signature: a ruled strip of minute blocks in phase colours; a freshly added block wipes in and is struck with an orange stroke.
components.css: .ds-tally{position:relative;display:flex;width:100%;max-width:520px;height:28px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line,#D8DEE8);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface-sunken,#E9EDF3)}.ds-tally>span{position:relative;height:100%;flex-shrink:0}.ds-tally>span+span{border-left:1px solid var(--surface-raised,#FFFFFF)}.ds-tally-rule{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent calc(100% - 1px),var(--surface-raised,#FFFFFF) 0);background-size:8.333% 100%}.ds-tally-fresh{animation:ds-fill 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) backwards}.ds-tally-fresh i{position:absolute;left:4px;right:4px;top:50%;height:2px;margin-top:-1px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--accent-bright,#F26A1B);transform-origin:left center;animation:ds-strike 520ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) forwards}@keyframes ds-fill{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}}@keyframes ds-strike{0%{transform:scaleX(0);opacity:1}55%{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:1}100%{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tally-fresh,.ds-tally-fresh i{animation:none}.ds-tally-fresh i{opacity:0}}

narrative.overview:
CoachOS is laid out like the scoresheet a coach signs after every game: a crisp, ruled, two-ink document. Structure is printed in scorer-blue ink; the coach's own marks are in orange. Every session, drill and minute is accounted for in boxes, hairlines and tabular figures, so the product reads as a record a coach can trust and hand out on paper. The world rejects the category default of a grey SaaS shell with one accent, and the dark "arena" of black ground and orange glow.

Light mode is a cool white sheet under bright gym lights, with blue-ink type. Dark mode is the same sheet under arena lights: a deep blue-ink ground (never neutral black) with sheet-white type and the same orange. A blue-ink rail, the sheet's printed header band, holds navigation in both themes. The `.arena` scope puts the dark sheet on the landing page, sign-in and onboarding whatever the app theme is.

Density is working-tool density: 44px controls for the on-court tablet, ruled lists rather than card mosaics, numbers set condensed and tabular so they line up like a scoresheet column. Motion is short and understated, except for one signature: the running tally, where minute blocks are struck in with an orange stroke.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks on sheet stock: scorer-blue for structure, orange for the coach's marks.
One hairline weight (1px) for every rule, border and divider.
One type family, Archivo, using its width axis: normal for interface, condensed for display, numbers and form labels.
Depth is a hairline plus a soft, blue-tinted offset shadow; no glow.
The running tally is the signature component; digit rolls and the orange "changed" mark are its supporting moves.
Photography and footage are content on Persuade surfaces and sport banners, never chrome.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Structure is blue ink; the coach's marks are orange. If an element is not something the coach did, chose or must act on, it is not orange.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Fills and strokes use the brand orange in both themes. Only orange text on the light sheet switches to the text-safe orange (coach-orange-text); orange text never sits on the light sheet at the fill value.

rules.name: The Blue Night Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is blue ink (arena-sheet, arena-raised, arena-sunken, arena-rail), never neutral black or grey.

rules.name: The Written-Out Rule
rules.body: A phase colour never stands alone: every tally, legend and timeline row also names the phase in words.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number a coach compares (minutes, counts, clock times) is set as a numeral: condensed, tabular. Tables are tabular by default.

rules.name: The Label Is Not a Kicker Rule
rules.body: The condensed caps label names a box or a small section. It never sits above a page heading as a kicker; the page title carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Sheet-on-Desk Rule
rules.body: Elevation is always hairline plus paper shadow. Never a shadow without a border, never a glow.

rules.name: The Opaque Sheet Rule
rules.body: Panels and cards are solid stock. Translucency with backdrop blur is reserved for sticky bars over scrolling content (top bar, tab bar, landing header) and the video pause control; it is never a panel material.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (surface, ink, line, accent, rail) in components; never raw hexes.
Do fill primary actions with the brand orange (coach-orange / arena-orange) and set blue-ink text on it in light mode.
Do use the text-safe orange (coach-orange-text) whenever orange is text on the light sheet.
Do keep dark mode in the blue-ink family: arena-sheet, arena-raised, arena-sunken, arena-rail.
Do set every comparable number as a condensed tabular numeral.
Do draw every rule at 1px from the hairline token.
Do write out the phase name wherever a phase colour appears.
Do label the featured session honestly: "Next on court" when one is scheduled ahead, "Latest session" otherwise.
Do keep UI motion between 120 and 240ms with the strong ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), animate only opacity and transform, and switch movement off under reduced motion and print.
Do keep cinematic photography and footage on Persuade surfaces and sport overview banners, with provenance recorded.
donts: Don't label a session "Tonight" or "Tonight's court" unless it is scheduled tonight.
Don't set orange text at the fill value (#F26A1B) on the light sheet.
Don't use neutral black or grey grounds in dark mode.
Don't use gradient text, glow, or glass panels; gradients appear only as legibility scrims over footage and as the tally's ruling.
Don't put a condensed caps label above a page heading as a kicker.
Don't use photography or footage as UI chrome (backgrounds behind controls, card textures, nav decoration).
Don't use orange for focus; focus is always the blue focus ring.
Don't add signature motion beyond the tally strike, digit roll and changed mark; the court-line draw and text rise are reserved for Persuade surfaces and onboarding.
